title: The Live Ghost
premise: Casper Marchetti, a ghost operative erased from every database fifteen years ago, receives a calendar invite from Handler Elena Voss—dead for six months. The meeting pulls Casper back into the orbit of Halcyon Group, the private security firm that owns their identity, where a ledger of compromised clients has gone missing and everyone from Casper's old team to a government fixer is hunting it. As Casper follows Elena's posthumous breadcrumbs, they discover she faked her death to protect the ledger—and that Casper is its final encryption key. Torn between loyalty to the handlers who made them and the truth Elena died protecting, Casper must decide whether to burn the evidence or expose an empire, trading their last secret—the location of Elena's hidden daughter—to board the dawn extraction flight as Halcyon burns behind them.
about_author: Mara Ravensworth spent a decade writing risk assessments for security firms before turning to fiction, drawing on the gray ethics of the protection industry. She lives off-grid in coastal Maine, where she writes thrillers about people whose names don't exist.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. Living under a new name in Lisbon, Casper receives a calendar invite from Elena Voss—dead six months—for tomorrow, 3 a.m., a dockside warehouse. Old tradecraft instincts war with grief; Casper verifies the invite's cryptographic signature and finds it authentic. Emotional beat: dread laced with hope that the one person who mattered isn't gone.

chapters.title: Ghost Protocol
chapters.summary: POV: Casper, flashback-woven. Preparing for the meeting, Casper reviews fifteen years of rewritten rules and erased identities, remembering how Elena recruited them out of a military prison. A surveillance sweep reveals Casper is already being followed. Emotional beat: the cost of invisibility—no one left to trust, no one left to mourn you.

chapters.title: Dead Drop at Dawn
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. At the warehouse, Casper finds not Elena but a dead man's phone playing her recorded voice: 'You were always the key.' A second team breaches the building; Casper escapes through flooding cargo tunnels, wounded. Emotional beat: betrayal sharpening into resolve—someone wanted this meeting witnessed.

chapters.title: Halcyon Days
chapters.summary: POV: Marcus Hale, Halcyon's operations director. Hale learns the Voss file has been unsealed and orders Casper brought in quietly, revealing to readers that Halcyon's client ledger contains state-level crimes. Emotional beat: cold institutional menace; Hale grieves Elena too, but differently—he helped bury her.

chapters.title: The Ledger
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. Deciphering Elena's message chain, Casper learns of the Black Ledger: fifteen years of Halcyon's dirtiest contracts, encrypted with a key derived from Casper's own biometric history. Every faction wants it. Emotional beat: horror at being a living password, a person reduced to a lock.

chapters.title: Old Team, New Orders
chapters.summary: POV: Priya Anand, former teammate now working contract jobs. Priya is offered a lucrative retainer to retrieve Casper alive and recognizes the client's shell company. She takes the job anyway, telling herself she'll protect Casper. Emotional beat: loyalty bending under money and old affection.

chapters.title: Safehouse Arithmetic
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. Hiding in a Prague safehouse, Casper calculates odds: three factions hunting them, seventy-two hours until Elena's final instruction unlocks. A near-miss with Halcyon's cleaners forces a brutal escape. Emotional beat: exhaustion and the strange freedom of having nothing left to lose.

chapters.title: What Elena Buried
chapters.summary: POV: Casper, deep flashback. Fifteen years ago, Elena falsified Casper's death record and built their legend—then hid something else that night: an infant daughter, Dani, placed with a family in Porto. Casper realizes the girl exists only in fragments of Elena's files. Emotional beat: tenderness cracking open a hardened operative.

chapters.title: The Fixer
chapters.summary: POV: Adrian Cole, a government fixer whose career depends on the Ledger never surfacing. Cole offers Casper immunity and a new life in exchange for the decryption key—and lets slip that Elena didn't die naturally. Emotional beat: seductive temptation wrapped around a threat.

chapters.title: Priya's Choice
chapters.summary: POV: Priya. Tracking Casper to Vienna, Priya instead warns them off, burning her retainer and her standing with Halcyon. Together they decode Elena's next layer: the extraction flight leaves from a private strip outside Trieste at dawn, day after tomorrow. Emotional beat: loyalty chosen over survival, friendship rekindled under fire.

chapters.title: Client Zero
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. Following Elena's trail to a retired senator on the Ledger's first page, Casper hears his confession: Halcyon's founder built the company on a massacre the senator ordered and Elena witnessed. Emotional beat: the sick weight of truth—exposure could topple governments or get thousands killed.

chapters.title: Rewritten Rules
chapters.summary: POV: Hale. Under pressure from Halcyon's founder, Aurelio Vance, Hale authorizes lethal force against Casper and discovers Cole is running a parallel op. He begins quietly copying files for himself. Emotional beat: a company man realizing the machine he served will feed on him next.

chapters.title: The Girl in Porto
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. Casper watches Dani from a distance—seventeen, unaware, laughing with friends—and understands Elena's real inheritance: not the Ledger, but a life kept clean of all this. Cole's surveillance arrives; Casper must leave without being seen. Emotional beat: love against duty crystallized in a single unbearable choice.

chapters.title: Interrogation of a Ghost
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. Captured by Cole's team, Casper endures a psychological interrogation designed to extract the key. They stall by feeding Cole partial truths, learning he suspects Vance ordered Elena's death. Priya triggers a blackout and springs them. Emotional beat: endurance, then furious gratitude.

chapters.title: Elena's Voice
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. In a Trieste archive box Elena rented years ago, Casper plays her full posthumous message: she faked her death when Vance discovered she'd copied the Ledger; the meeting invitation was her failsafe, timed to her daughter's safety window. Emotional beat: grief transfigured into purpose—a dead woman still fighting for her child.

chapters.title: Three Ways Out
chapters.summary: POV: Priya. Planning the extraction, the trio maps contingencies: fly with the Ledger and become targets forever; destroy it and let Vance win; leak it and trigger chaos. Hale makes contact, offering Halcyon's internal proof in exchange for passage. Emotional beat: the arithmetic of impossible choices, trust stretched thin.

chapters.title: Vance
chapters.summary: POV: Aurelio Vance. The founder confronts Casper directly at a neutral-site parley, offering everything—wealth, erasure, even Elena's true cause of death—if they hand over the key. He reveals Elena trusted Casper precisely because they'd choose duty over love. Emotional beat: charisma as a weapon; doubt planted like shrapnel.

chapters.title: The Airfield
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. Dawn approaches at the Trieste airstrip as three converging teams—Cole's, Hale's defectors, Vance's cleaners—close in. Casper initiates the decryption while Priya holds the perimeter; gunfire erupts across the tarmac. Emotional beat: adrenaline-fueled clarity, every debt coming due at once.

chapters.title: Key Turned
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. Mid-battle, the Ledger opens: fifteen years of atrocities, including proof Vance murdered Elena. Casper must choose in seconds—upload it globally, hand it to Cole, or burn it. They broadcast it to forty newsrooms and governments simultaneously, then wipe their own copy. Emotional beat: liberation and irrevocability; the secret dies so the truth lives.

chapters.title: Extraction
chapters.summary: POV: Priya. The plane lifts off as Vance's cleaners breach the runway; Hale stays behind to delay them, buying the escape with his life. Cole, exposed by the leak, chooses not to fire on the climbing aircraft. Emotional beat: costly victory—survival purchased with sacrifice.

chapters.title: Inheritance
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. Weeks later, watching fallout ripple through governments, Casper travels to Porto and finally meets Dani—not as a handler or guardian, but as the friend Elena asked them to be, delivering letters and a trust fund. Emotional beat: quiet redemption; love fulfilled without possession.

chapters.title: The Live Ghost
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. On a coastal cliff, Casper reads Elena's last line—'A ghost is only someone the living refuse to see'—and sends one final anonymous tip that finishes Vance. Then Casper walks into a small town, uses their real name for the first time in fifteen years, and orders coffee. Emotional beat: resurrection; the invisible choosing, at last, to be seen.
